type: ({ feedback, reason, onFeedbackChange, onCopy, announcement, onCopyAnnouncement, onRegenerate, labels, }: FeedbackBarProps) => JSX.Element
description:
What the person can do with a finished answer (spec section 11): copy it,
ask for another, and rate it helpful or not helpful, the latter with a
reason. Each button shows only when its handler exists, and the ratings are
toggles. The bar has no status of its own, so the owner pattern keeps the one
live region when announcement is off. «نُسخت» is always rendered so the
buttons never shift under the pointer; for two seconds after a copy it turns
visible, and the copy button keeps its name.

parameters.name:
{
  feedback,
  reason,
  onFeedbackChange,
  onCopy,
  announcement = "polite",
  onCopyAnnouncement,
  onRegenerate,
  labels,
}

announcement.description: Speak copy feedback locally, or leave it to the containing pattern.

onCopy.description: The host copies the answer; «نُسخت» shows once its promise resolves.

onCopyAnnouncement.description:
Reports "" when copying starts, then the localized confirmation on success.
Pair with announcement="off" to reuse the owner's live region.

onFeedbackChange.description:
`value` is null when the person takes their rating back; a reason comes
only with "down".

reason.description: The reason picked for a "down"; without it the bar keeps its own.
